name: Youfu
source:
Main character is a director of a nursing home, and 20 days before building demolition he confines the girls there and teaches them love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一家疗养院的院长，在拆除大楼的前20天，他将女孩们关在里面，教她们爱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
